name: Dhruv Jhalani
player_statement:
A complete player, Dhruv Jhalani has made a big mark in cricket. With 18 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 50, with an average of 26.92 and a quick strike rate of 142.29. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 23 sixes and 16 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 22.0 overs, taking 11 wickets at an economy rate of 5.64. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
